semantics: Data-driven meta TasteGate obligations that supplement Lean ChapterTasteGate without replacing it.
monotonicity: Obligations add machine-checkable rejection criteria; they are not relaxed in place.

obligations.rejects_because: A carrier whose canonical payload is identical to a different-domain carrier is under-encoded: the carrier does not encode the distinction its name claims.

provenance.boundary: meta-level obligation; existing carriers are reported informationally
